resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the tower to 1941, but the register's panorama caption and the weebly listing date a view of the Porcupine Ridge Lookout to July 22, 1935. No source reconciles the two dates or says whether an earlier structure stood there. The story reports 1941 as the date both descriptions give and notes the 1935 date.

corrections.why: Both the register and firelookout.com say the tower is in ruins, so the record should use the ruins status (footings or remains only)
Spacing only; the register's spelling is U.S.Forest Service, so this is a formatting change to the agency name

notes_for_editor: Three sources. The 1941 build date and the 1935 panorama conflict and no source explains it; the story reports both. Other lookouts named Porcupine Ridge (Glacier National Park, Montana; Weyerhaeuser Vail Tree Farm, Washington) were excluded. A Facebook post from Memories of Morrow County that the search snippet connects to this lookout returned only its title on fetch, so it was not used. Photo image URLs were not captured; the register's 1935 panorama (credit: National Archives-Pacific Northwest Region) and 2009 site photo (credit: Rex Kamstra) are mentioned in text only. No source describes the site today or gives access.
